# 1_34

<span class="tada-chip tada-chip--warn">stopped early</span>

## Reproduce

```bash
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 python -u main.py --env windowed --reward-mode outcome_pbrs --init-weights experiments/atc_run_1_33_windowed_seqobs/final_model.zip --n-envs 16 --critic-warmup-steps 300000 --lr-max 3e-05 --final-lr 3e-06 --ent-coef 0.003 --total-timesteps 5000000

# score: 20-flight and stitched 2x20, 10 attempts, lookahead (100 validation seeds)
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_34_windowed_outcome/checkpoints/ppo_tada_799744_steps.zip --seeds 100 --attempts 9
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_34_windowed_outcome/checkpoints/ppo_tada_799744_steps.zip --seeds 100 --segments 2 --gap 120 900
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_34_windowed_outcome/checkpoints/ppo_tada_799744_steps.zip --seeds 100 --lookahead 4
```
